literal_meaning: ঘোষণা বা স্বীকৃতির দলিল (declaration or agreement document)
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই ইকরারনামায় সব শর্ত কবুল হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He made an iqrar of his mistake.
All conditions have been admitted in this agreement document.
history: Derived from Arabic 'iqrar' meaning declaration, introduced through Islamic legal traditions in Bengal during Mughal era.
note: Often used in formal and legal contexts in Bengali, reflecting Persian-Arabic linguistic influence.
